page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m8.4xlarge is a virtual workstation instance utilizing an Intel Xeon 8369B CPU operating at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. The instance provisions 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with two hyperthreads per core running on a dedicated KVM hypervisor platform. System memory totals 62 GB, delivering 3.88 GB per vCPU. Hardware graphics acceleration is supplied by a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU allocation with 8 GB of VRAM. Local SSD storage is not included on the instance payload, requiring network-attached storage for persistent operational data. Baseline network throughput is configured at 5 Gbps.

The underlying Intel x86_64 architecture incorporates AVX-512 extensions including VNNI, alongside hardware-accelerated cryptographic instructions such as AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. Benchmark evaluation places the instance in average percentiles across compute and memory workloads, recording a Geekbench multi-core score of 12885.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 29217.88. Large block memory read throughput reaches 92.11 GB/sec, while write throughput measures 28.19 GB/sec. Small LLM inference benchmarks using a 7B parameter model yield 32.87 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 10.13 tokens/sec for text generation.

Qualitatively, partitioning an NVIDIA A10 GPU provides an efficient entry point for graphics workloads that do not demand a full dedicated GPU frame buffer. The omission of local instance storage balances cost against the requirement for external block storage attachment. This hardware profile is appropriate for virtual workstation desktops, image processing pipelines, light machine learning inference, software compilation, and web serving.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m8.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual workstation instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz across 16 vCPUs and 8 physical cores. The server features 62 GB of system memory, 48 MB of L3 cache, and dedicated CPU allocation on a KVM hypervisor. Graphics acceleration is provided by a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU instance with 8 GB of VRAM. The server omits local storage, relying on network storage volumes, and maintains a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps. Synthetic benchmarks place its compute, memory throughput, and small-scale LLM inference capabilities in middle-tier percentiles. Supported hardware extensions include AVX-512 VNNI, VAES, and SHA_NI. This configuration is aligned with virtual desktop tasks, media processing, light AI model inference, and software compilation.
